description: Search live OLX ads by keyword with category, price, condition, seller type, location, delivery and sort. 1 point per returned record.

condition.description: Condition. Options: new = New, almost-new = Almost new, used = Used, refurbished = Refurbished, outlet = Outlet, damaged = Damaged, others = Others

domain.description: Marketplace. Options: olx.pl = olx.pl (Poland), olx.ua = olx.ua (Ukraine), olx.ro = olx.ro (Romania), olx.bg = olx.bg (Bulgaria), olx.pt = olx.pt (Portugal), olx.kz = olx.kz (Kazakhstan), olx.uz = olx.uz (Uzbekistan)

owner_type.description: Seller type. Options: private = Private sellers, business = Business sellers

sort.description: Sort by. Options: relevance = Relevance, newest = Newest, oldest = Oldest, price_asc = Price: low to high, price_desc = Price: high to low

start_page.description: Starting page (50 offers per page, up to 20)

name: run_olx_offers_search
